brief: A herb planter with soil in its bins that is non-toxic if my cat chews on it.

requirements.evidence: 3x piece full + 3x bin hex-bin-full (bin:0,0,0, bin:0,1,0, bin:1,0,0)
fillSoil on all three bins via fill_and_plant, planted basil-young, parsley-young, thyme-young

Parts are 3D-printed in a user-chosen material the configurator does not check; toxicity/food-safety cannot be verified. Shape provides open bins with soil and common culinary herbs, but material non-toxicity if chewed cannot be claimed.
requirements.requirement: Non-toxic if cat chews on it

finish.summary: 3-cell planter with full-depth bins, each filled with soil and planted (basil, parsley, thyme). Non-toxic material cannot be guaranteed – print in a material you have verified as safe and keep chewing supervised.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
